full_name: Sonal Khullar | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Humanities Hilles Bush Fellow University of Pennsylvania
bio: Sonal Khullar is an art historian who writes on modern and contemporary art from South Asia, with a particular interest in histories of cosmopolitanism, postcolonial art worlds, and critical historiographies of art.
